nef30a72bc8.headline: Investment as a hedge: coronavirus and the economy impacted the agricultural machinery sector
nef30a72bc8.summary: Presidents of chambers representing national and international agricultural machinery companies reviewed the challenges and investment trends during an atypical year affected by the coronavirus and economic changes.
nef30a72bc8.why: The agricultural machinery sector is sensitive to economic cycles and investment trends, which affect equipment demand and rural economies.
